title: Re-check and remove a custom domain
caption: Needs FEATURE_CUSTOM_DOMAINS. Mirrors admin-domains.e2e.ts.

steps.title: Find pending domains
steps.body: **To review** → 'custom domains wait for their DNS records' (→ `/domains?kind=custom&verificationStatus=pending`).
steps.expect: Host, OTA, kind, DNS verification with the 72-hour window end, last DNS check in words, TLS state, added.

steps.title: Re-check
steps.expect: 'checks are queued, reload in a minute'; after reload the last check time moved; `domain.recheck_requested` in the audit.

steps.title: Remove
steps.body: **Remove** → reason → **Remove domain** (an empty reason shows 'Enter a reason.').
steps.expect: Row gone at once; owners get '<host> was removed from <OTA>' without the reason; sub-domain primary again; no Remove on sub-domains.
